hints.content:
The time when Zane started climbing up is the same as $0$ seconds since he started to climb. So we need to look for the point on the graph where **Time** is $0$, which is the $y$-intercept.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A fourth quadrant coordinate plane. The horizontal axis is from zero to thirty-seven point five with a scale of two point five and is titled Time in seconds. The vertical axis is from negative thirty to ten with a scale of two point five and is titled Elevation in meters. The graph of the line is y equals five-sevenths x minus twenty-five. The graph ends at each axis. The point zero, negative twenty-five is plotted.

hints.content: The $y$-intercept is $(0,-25)$, which means that **when Zane started climbing up, he was $25$ meters below the edge of the volcano.**

question.content:
While exploring a volcano, Zane heard some rumbling, so he decided to climb up out of there as quickly as he could.

Zane's elevation relative to the edge of the inside of the volcano (in meters) as a function of time (in seconds) is graphed.



[[☃ image 1]]

**How far was Zane from the edge of the volcano when he started climbing?**

[[☃ numeric-input 1]] meters
